description: How big a rooftop solar system should be for a household near Munich: from today's consumption plus a planned heat pump or electric car, the roof orientation and (optionally) the usable roof area. Uses the same model as the calculator in Sky Solar's guide. An illustration, not a quote.

carKwh.description: Extra kWh a year for a planned electric car charged at home (0 if none)

consumptionKwh.description: Electricity the household uses today, kWh a year

heatPumpKwh.description: Extra kWh a year for a planned heat pump (0 if none)

locale.description: Language of the answer: de (German) or en (English).

roofM2.description: Usable roof area in m² (without windows, chimneys, shaded parts), if known

name: size_system
title: Size a solar system
